column1: # tools/deb/control.tsv: the control fields of the Debian packages (PKG-MANIFEST), read by
# tools/deb/manifest.py for the build (tools/deb/build.sh, system.sh) and the checks (check.sh,
# check-system.sh). No spec clause: release packaging (deb-control(5); the system packages' values:
# Columns, tab-separated: package, field, value. Sorted (LC_ALL=C sort), one row per field.
#   A capitalised field is a control field. The build writes Package, Source (niji), Version,
#   Architecture, Maintainer and Installed-Size first, then the package's other fields in the
#   order Essential, Multi-Arch, Pre-Depends, Depends, Recommends, Suggests, Provides, Breaks,
#   Conflicts, Replaces, Section, Priority, then the Description: the text of
#   tools/deb/description/<package> (synopsis line, then the extended lines).
#   Placeholders the build fills: $version (the packages' version), $abi (the ABI level, 2.39),
#   $provides (libc6's virtual packages, from tools/deb/symbols.py --provides); in a description
#   also $programs (the names of the package's file rows under usr/sbin, then usr/bin, each
#   triggers: one line of the DEBIAN/triggers member (deb-triggers(5)).
#   symbols: the package's DEBIAN/symbols and DEBIAN/shlibs, written by the named generator.
#   debug: the package that holds the detached debugging information (the manifest's strip debug
# The conffiles member lists the package's manifest rows under etc/.

column3: the detached debugging information of the other packages' strip-debug rows
